label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from request header 'Referer' flows directly into response body via PrintWriter.println(bar.toCharArray()) without HTML encoding. The switch statement conditionally uses param based on a hardcoded character ('C'), which is reachable. Disabling X-XSS-Protection header exacerbates risk. No sanitization occurs.

evidence.note: Source: User input retrieved from Referer header
Switch logic assigns user input to variable bar
Sink: Unencoded output written to HTTP response
